items.name: Arya
items.blurb: Recreational runner with a regular schedule. Her story: an illness-like pattern, a low-oxygen night and a tracker dropout.

items.name: Daniel
items.blurb: Late, irregular schedule. His story: three short nights, then a stressful afternoon.

items.name: Priya
items.blurb: A steady routine with nothing injected. She shows how quiet the system stays when nothing is wrong.
